about: Made-up raw transcripts for tools/cleanup_eval.py. Never put real dictations here: those go in data/cleanup_evals_private.json (add-from-history). Checks: has (text that must appear, exact; a list inside means any one of them), lacks (must not appear, any case), keeps (words that must survive, any case), max_words, no_line_breaks (true: fails if the answer is split over lines). Every case also must pass cleanup's safety nets (not empty, not much longer, nothing dropped).
